learnings.title: Copilot SDK server-to-server auth requires organization-owned installation and billable usage
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog 2026-10-27 confirms Copilot SDK server-to-server authentication is a public preview for GitHub Apps installed on organizations, using a short-lived installation token and read-only organization Copilot Requests permission; model usage is billed to the organization under its policies and budgets. This does not grant an existing connector access, remove human approval, or establish a free model invocation path.
learnings.decision: COPILOT_ORG_AUTH_BUDGET_GATE: REVIEW_ONLY. Do not enable Copilot SDK server-to-server authentication unless a GitHub organization owner explicitly authorizes a least-privilege app installation, verifies Copilot Requests permission, confirms usage budget and cost controls, and tests the workload. Keep existing connector permissions unchanged; no bypass or free-access claim.
learnings.next_measurement: Read-only check whether any system workflow actually uses the Copilot SDK and whether an organization-owned installation/budget exists; absent proof, mark not applicable.
fallback_history: Continue existing permissioned GitHub read-only API and CI verification at no extra Copilot model cost.

learnings.title: Shopify Dev Dashboard app earnings and install details are not storefront sales evidence
learnings.claim: Shopify developer changelog 2026-10-27 confirms Dev Dashboard store and app install details show an organization's installed apps, collaborators, app/theme earnings, installation and billing events, and app subscriptions only according to store access and permissions; these developer-app metrics are not evidence of merchant storefront traffic, product demand, or orders.
learnings.decision: SHOPIFY_DEV_DASHBOARD_SCOPE_GATE: REVIEW_ONLY. Use Dev Dashboard metrics only for owned app-install or collaborator monitoring where access is confirmed. Never substitute app earnings/install counts for merchant storefront conversion, orders, traffic or product demand; prefer authorized merchant analytics for those decisions.
learnings.next_measurement: Confirm whether video_shopify operates a Shopify developer app with Dev Dashboard access; otherwise mark not applicable and do not request extra permissions.
fallback_history: Keep merchant demand unverified until authorized merchant sales/traffic reports exist; no paid tool required.
